rows.vgi.doc_llm: Search package or image repository metadata within an explicit source and row budget. Find package names or image repositories before requesting their detailed metadata. Native search keeps provider ranking; scores are provider-specific and nullable. Prepared indexes use case-insensitive substring matching and deterministic name order. Inspect image platform descriptors and their exact manifest digests

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect image platform descriptors and their exact manifest digests. For a multi-platform index, return each child manifest's digest, media type, size, OS, architecture and optional variant; index_digest identifies the verified parent. A single-platform manifest returns its platform from a verified configuration blob. Descriptor values are preserved as reported; child manifests are verified when fetched. Select a platform digest for layers or configuration rather than passing the multi-platform index. Return ordered layer descriptors from one verified platform manifest. position is zero-based; digest is the layer blob digest; size is the declared compressed byte count. Inspect prepared index readiness, revisions, freshness and discovery boundaries

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect prepared index readiness, revisions, freshness and discovery boundaries. One row per source_id describing search readiness. Join to sources using source_id for endpoint details. Indexed sources report the last committed snapshot, observation time, source revision, record count, checkpoint, declared coverage and completeness. complete means the declared input was exhausted, not ecosystem-wide coverage. Native readiness indicates adapter availability, not a remote health probe. Failed inspection produces ready=false and a safe error code. This relation is both a table and a zero-argument function. Inspect a container repository description and provider metadata

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect a container repository description and provider metadata. Read one Docker Hub or Quay repository's provider description and available star/pull counts. Inspect supported source operations and native or indexed search coverage

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Inspect supported source operations and native or indexed search coverage. One row per source_id and operation. Join this relation to sources using source_id to obtain the endpoint and authentication settings. supported reports adapter support even when an index has not been prepared. Package operations are search, package, versions, artifacts and dependencies; container operations are search, repository, tags, manifest, platforms, layers and configuration. searched_fields is a comma-separated list for search and NULL for other operations. Inspect description for operation-specific limits. This relation is both a table and a zero-argument function. Result columns (nullable when upstream data is unavailable): source_id `VARCHAR`: Configured source identifier. ecosystem `VARCHAR`: Adapter ecosystem. operation `VARCHAR`: Operation name. supported `BOOLEAN`: Whether this adapter supports the operation. search_mode `VARCHAR`: native or indexed for search. searched_fields `VARCHAR`: Fields included in search. authentication `VARCHAR`: Configured authentication mode. description `VARCHAR`: Operation constraints.
